name: Pentagon Syndrome
source:
Kana, a psychology student, meets a mysterious man, Karasu, at a college party. Though he remains distant and elusive, he introduces Kana to his four flatmates - Bunta, Sei, Okame and Kiba.
"I bet you know how to kill us."
Kana becomes involved with the five, thinking she'd rather help them live.
